label: Climate and volume touch controls not illuminated at night
symptom: The climate control sliders and volume touch controls are not illuminated in the dark, making them difficult to see and operate at night.
inspection_advice: Check visibility of touch controls in low-light conditions.

label: Slow, unresponsive, and frustrating infotainment interface
symptom: The infotainment system operates with slow, non-smartphone-like software and houses climate and seat controls, making it infuriating and difficult to use while driving.
inspection_advice: Test infotainment responsiveness and menu navigation during a test drive.
